text: The constant c in the accel_step fit a*(a/r - c) is 0.55-0.56 at 4 layers / d_model=64 and 0.50-0.54 at 6 layers / d_model=128. Does c converge to exactly 0.5 (vis-viva) as models grow or train longer? Does a linear probe for a^2*(2/r - 1/a) at layer 6 match or beat accel_step's R2 of 0.92-0.93?
